verses.pali: “Sasaññā, bhikkhave, uppajjanti pāpakā akusalā dhammā, no asaññā.
verses.english: “Bad, unskillful qualities, mendicants, arise with perception, not without perception.

verses.pali: Tassāyeva saññāya pahānā evaṁ te pāpakā akusalā dhammā na hontī”ti.
verses.english: By giving up that perception, those bad, unskillful qualities do not occur.”
